scripts.build: npm run assets && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.test: npm run assets && tsc --outDir .test-build && node --test tests/*.mjs
scripts.format: prettier --write src tests scripts index.html vite.config.ts tsconfig.json package.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src tests scripts index.html vite.config.ts tsconfig.json package.json
